question: How does the same reality become the paths of phonemes and words?
premises: In the form of valid cognition, the reality is declared to be the path of phonemes.
When it assumes the form of the means of knowledge, it becomes the path of words.
inference: The same reality appears as the phoneme path in the mode of cognition and as the word path in the mode of the cognitive instrument.
plain_english: In the form of valid cognition, this reality is called the path of phonemes; when it takes the form of the means of knowledge, it becomes the path of words.
